name: Prospect Hill Marketplace
summary: Prospect Hill Marketplace is a 176,000 square foot community shopping center in East Windsor, Connecticut, anchored by Big Y Supermarket. Located on Route 5 adjacent to I-91, the center offers convenient grocery and retail shopping with excellent visibility and highway access.
demographics: Prospect Hill Marketplace serves a primarily middle-income suburban demographic within a seven-mile radius of East Windsor, Connecticut. The trade area attracts families and working professionals who value convenient access to grocery shopping and everyday retail needs, with easy accessibility from I-91 making it a destination for commuters and residents from surrounding communities. The center's anchor tenant Big Y Supermarket draws regular weekly shoppers focused on household essentials, while the location on Route 5 captures both local residents and pass-through traffic seeking convenient shopping options.
description: Prospect Hill Marketplace is a well-positioned community shopping center located in East Windsor, Connecticut, offering convenient retail and grocery shopping to residents within a seven-mile radius. Anchored by Big Y Supermarket, a beloved New England grocery chain, the center provides essential shopping services to the local community with exceptional visibility and accessibility. Strategically situated on Route 5, directly adjacent to Interstate 91, Prospect Hill Marketplace benefits from high traffic counts and easy highway access, making it a natural stop for both local residents and regional travelers. The 176,000 square foot center is professionally managed by WS Development, a respected real estate firm known for creating vibrant retail destinations throughout the Northeast. With its combination of grocery anchor, convenient location, and strong regional access, Prospect Hill Marketplace serves as a reliable shopping destination for East Windsor and the surrounding Connecticut River Valley communities.
